places.name: Christ the Redeemer (Corcovado)
places.ai_summary: Christ the Redeemer is an iconic statue located atop Corcovado Mountain, offering panoramic views of Rio de Janeiro. It is one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during holidays.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to avoid crowds and enjoy the best views.
places.address: Parque Nacional da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.name: Sugarloaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar)
places.ai_summary: Sugarloaf Mountain is a granite peak offering breathtaking views of Rio de Janeiro. Visitors can take a cable car to the summit for a unique perspective of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last cable car departs at 19:30.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for stunning views of the city lights.
places.address: Av. Pasteur, 520 - Urca, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.name: Copacabana Beach
places.ai_summary: Copacabana Beach is one of the most famous beaches in the world, known for its vibrant atmosphere, golden sands, and iconic promenade.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for swimming and sunbathing.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coconut water from one of the beachside vendors.
places.address: Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.name: Ipanema Beach
places.ai_summary: Ipanema Beach is renowned for its stunning beauty, lively atmosphere, and the famous song 'The Girl from Ipanema.'

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the afternoon for a vibrant crowd.

places.place_tip: Watch the sunset from the Arpoador rock.
places.address: Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.name: Maracanã Stadium
places.ai_summary: Maracanã Stadium is one of the most famous football stadiums in the world, hosting iconic matches and events.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary on event days.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for matches or events for a lively experience.
places.address: Av. Maracanã, 255 - Maracanã, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.name: Selarón Steps (Escadaria Selarón)
places.ai_summary: The Selarón Steps are a colorful staircase created by artist Jorge Selarón, featuring over 2000 brightly colored tiles from over 60 countries.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for photography.

places.place_tip: Be respectful of the local community and the artist's work.
places.address: R. Joaquim Silva, 9 - Santa Teresa, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.name: Tijuca National Park
places.ai_summary: Tijuca National Park is one of the largest urban rainforests in the world, offering a lush escape from the city with hiking trails, waterfalls, and diverse wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 16:00. Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water for hiking.
places.address: Estr. da Cascatinha - Alto da Boa Vista, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.name: Botanical Garden (Jardim Botânico)
places.ai_summary: The Botanical Garden is a beautiful and tranquil place in Rio de Janeiro, featuring a vast collection of Brazilian and foreign plants, trees, and flowers.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the orchidarium and the tropical plant sector.

places.place_tip: Explore the local art galleries and studios.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the vibrant nightlife and live music in the area.

places.ai_summary: The Museum of Tomorrow is a science museum in Rio de Janeiro, focused on sustainability and the future of our planet, featuring interactive exhibits and a striking architectural design.

places.place_tip: Check out the rooftop for a great view of the city.

places.ai_summary: The Rio de Janeiro Cathedral is a modern cathedral known for its unique architecture resembling a giant concrete cone, and its impressive stained-glass windows.

places.place_tip: Respect the religious practices and dress modestly.
places.address: Av. República do Chile, 245 - Centro, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for swimming and sunbathing.

places.place_tip: Try the seafood at one of the beachside restaurants.
places.address: Leblon, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brazil

places.ai_summary: The Urca Hill Trail is a popular hiking trail in Rio de Janeiro, offering stunning views of the city, Sugarloaf Mountain, and the Guanabara Bay.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring water and wear comfortable shoes for hiking.

places.ai_summary: Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon is a large lagoon in the southern zone of Rio de Janeiro, surrounded by mountains and offering a scenic spot for leisure and sports.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for a variety of activities.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike or paddleboat to explore the lagoon.

places.ai_summary: AquaRio is the largest aquarium in South America, featuring a wide variety of marine life and offering interactive experiences.

places.place_tip: Check out the feeding times for a more interactive experience.

places.ai_summary: Flamengo Park is a large public park in Rio de Janeiro, featuring gardens, museums, and a marina, and offering a variety of recreational activities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for walking, jogging, or cycling.

places.place_tip: Visit the Museum of Modern Art located within the park.

places.ai_summary: An excursion to Ilha Grande Island offers a chance to explore one of Brazil's most beautiful islands, with pristine beaches, lush rainforests, and rich biodiversity.

opening_hours.notes: Best to book a guided tour for the excursion.

places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen, water, and a camera to capture the stunning scenery.
